mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of periods with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market with rising wages boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain resilience, enhances investor confidence in corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1400k units, signaling robust housing demand, a broader economic expansion is likely, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of periods with HOUST above 1400k.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance with tame inflation supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 0.5pp increase in UNRATE, indicating labor market softening, prompts investors to reassess growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $700B, signaling strong retail sales, a broad-based economic expansion is confirmed, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of non-recessionary periods with RSAFS above $700B.
